provenance_passport_contract.purpose: Make every public AI output readable, questionable, correctable and removable.
provenance_passport_contract.display_rule: Show original evidence and machine interpretation as distinct layers; do not publish unknown, uncleared or disputed content as settled fact.
provenance_passport_contract.fallback_rule: If the passport is incomplete, pause the output and route the user to source evidence or a staffed service channel.
